question: Who in the world can be released from bondage by the Lord's agency?
premises: Release from bondage is possible in the world.
The Lord is the agent of release.
Anyone so favored by the Lord is released from bondage.
inference: Whoever is released by the Lord in this world is indeed freed from bondage.
uncertainties: The rhetorical force of ko api vā is slightly ambiguous between 'whoever' and 'who at all'.
plain_english: Whoever in this world is released by you is indeed freed from bondage.
